name: The New Neighbors Have a Hot Tub

date.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recap, dated 20 July 2007 in its own byline

matches.note: General Mayhem won with Shot at Dawn at 8:44.

matches.stipulation: Ladder match for the MBE World Tag Team Championship
matches.note: The Thrillbillies retained after Jake McCody dove off a balcony to land on top of the belts, which Juen Lee had grabbed loose in the chaos; the referee counted it as a successful defense.
Johnny Onan won by referee stoppage at 5:32 after popping ROBOYORI's head off with the Headlock from Hell.
Jeffrey Roberts won with a Running Lyger Bomb at 8:56; the win earned him an automatic bye into the Lord of the Boards semifinals.

matches.stipulation: For the MBE World Heavyweight Championship
matches.note: Doc Silver retained with a top-rope Ace's Full Stunner at 22:25.

note: The debut show of MBE's fwrestling.com era, its first broadcast on the in-fiction network ESEN.

name: Singled Out

date.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recap, dated 8/7/07 in its own byline

matches.stipulation: Lord of the Boards, first round
matches.note: General Mayhem won with Shot at Dawn at 9:57, advancing to face Jeffrey Roberts in the semifinals.

matches.stipulation: Lord of the Boards, first round
matches.note: Justin Evitable won with a small package at 10:24, advancing to face Johnny Onan in the semifinals.

Originally billed as a tag match pairing Frankie Scott with Jeff Hawkins against the whole Sheffield Wednesday Lot; the Lot ambushed Frankie Scott backstage before the bell, leaving Jeff Hawkins to face Mac Forrest alone. Hawkins won with the Blackjack at 5:45.

matches.stipulation: Lord of the Boards, first round
matches.note: Johnny Onan won with the Headlock from Hell at 13:35, advancing to face Justin Evitable in the semifinals.

note: A scheduled tag match pairing Jeffrey Roberts and Doc Silver against Promo and Bryan Storms did not take place: Jeffrey Roberts instead ambushed Bryan Storms backstage, and Doc Silver separately attacked Promo in a locker-room angle while disguised as ROBOYORI.

date.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recap, dated 8/22/07 in its own byline

matches.note: Frankie Scott's official MBE debut match; he won with the Maximum Ride at 4:47.
Jeffrey Roberts won with the Shooting Star Guillotine at 13:02, advancing to the Lord of the Boards final.
PTSD pinned Hoss Garrison with the Stress Disorder at 10:22.
Justin Evitable entered hurt after a pre-show ambush by Jeffrey Roberts; Johnny Onan won with the Headlock from Hell at 16:35, advancing to face Jeffrey Roberts in the Lord of the Boards final.
